subject.title: feat(gateway): add deferred activation control port

question: Should OpenClaw core permanently expose inherited-environment deferred Gateway activation for external orchestrators?
rationale: Fixing the exit-status defect does not decide whether this specialized startup protocol and its security boundary belong in core long term.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Sponsor the core primitive after supervisor-safe validation, documentation, and Gateway/daemon owner review are complete.

options.title: Keep orchestration external
options.body: Decline the new core surface unless the Lobster integration demonstrates that existing launcher or container seams cannot satisfy the requirement.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Sponsor the core primitive after supervisor-safe validation, documentation, and Gateway/daemon owner review are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline shows direct interest, and merged history connects this person to Gateway diagnostics, daemon supervision, and configuration-flow ownership.
